decisions.reason: The healthcare and hospitality recruitment service is still far from the core, and after two years the website shows no results that reveal its value; it stays open for now because running it on the existing recruitment infrastructure costs little, but it is the weakest option in the portfolio.
The Smart Academy quickly grew to six partner institutions, builds directly on the firm's training centres and costs little to keep, so the evidence supports further commitment.
FuelEU Maritime compliance is mandatory, and the firm met the monitoring-plan deadline for all vessels, so this service is close to the core and its value is largely realized.
The FuelEU dashboard is already integrated into the PAL ship management software, so keeping it costs little, and regulatory demand gives it clear value as part of the compliance offer.

The cost simulator sits inside PAL and costs little to keep; its stand-alone value is less certain than the dashboard's, but it fits the firm's push into efficiency and environmental services, so the option stays open.
